keyFindings.description: A 404 issue query is refetched on every issue.updated and issue.closed event: api/sse.ts pushes ["issue"] for all three issue events and refreshQueries invalidates every active match, so each key-shaped word on screen (UTF-8) costs one GET /api/v1/issues/{key} per issue event anywhere, per tab. Plan Step 3.6 says only issue.created refetches a 404, and the comments at reference-target.ts:52-85 and useRenderedMarkdown.tsx:35-37 say so. Fix: issue.updated/issue.closed skip issue queries whose error is a 404 (issue.created and a stream reconnect keep refetching them), with a unit test.

The live editor draws a #id's title over a trailing - or _ that the renderer leaves as text: scanEditorReferences keeps the candidate's whole run (textReferences('see #q2- now') gives #q2-@4-8) while questionReference trims to q2, so the decoration hides the author's '-'. Design 4 says the editor uses the same rules; implement.json trickyParts lists it as known. Fix so the decorated range is the #id the renderer links.

useBareReferences filters keys by name but #ids by one boolean: in 'See \#q2 and #q3' the server indexes only q3 (backslash is no mention start; raw scan gives #q3 only), but the rendered text 'See #q2 and #q3' yields both and linkifyDispatchRefs links q2, a link with no Referenced-by edge. Fix: carry the written #ids and link only those.

questionBlocks reads directive lines with no notion of code fences: a fenced example ':::ask{#q9 copied_from="<uuid>"}' is returned as a declaration (probe via go test -overlay: [{id:q9 copiedFrom:1111...}]), so QuestionMap maps #q9 to that ask while pmdoc settlement never treats the fenced line as a block. Fix: skip lines inside fenced code blocks, with a scope_test row (the existing fenced :::ask{#fake} row at scope_test.go:224 asserts the opposite reading).
